<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **15** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/rest/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**20** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 631d77f3021ca00e36a3cb51e19a4d8ee361fdc6`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/rest/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **44** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 631d77f3021ca00e36a3cb51e19a4d8ee361fdc6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `51969aae4c4fc9368608f76fc8bdf6c40f738002` — the merge of head `0ba6987aec1cd73f9a97fa417355a7930302ceae` into base `631d77f3021ca00e36a3cb51e19a4d8ee361fdc6`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 51969aae4c4fc9368608f76fc8bdf6c40f738002 && git checkout 51969aae4c4fc9368608f76fc8bdf6c40f738002
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 631d77f3021ca00e36a3cb51e19a4d8ee361fdc6 0ba6987aec1cd73f9a97fa417355a7930302ceae && git checkout -B drift-repro 631d77f3021ca00e36a3cb51e19a4d8ee361fdc6 && git merge --no-ff 0ba6987aec1cd73f9a97fa417355a7930302ceae

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 631d77f3021ca00e36a3cb51e19a4d8ee361fdc6
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 631d77f3021ca00e36a3cb51e19a4d8ee361fdc6` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `989f4ad7bff2f0a210e9eddb89a01505edd3c048`
Local-runs: none
Scope: NON-PROSE-PATHS + CITED-FILES — every non-prose path of the diff; cited and read on the head: objectql `registry.ts`, `protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`, `protocol-registry-hydration.ts`, `protocol-lock-state.ts`, Console `DocPage.tsx`, `doc-links.ts`, `appRoute.ts`, ADR-0150 D1/D3/D5, ruling 6893582352.
Security-touching: yes

No earlier record on this PR. Cards #34247 and #34248 read with every comment. All findings are from reading the head tree; nothing was run.

### ① Derived judgments

- Exact `?package=X` read, X holds no item: 200 another holder's → 404, on `readMetaItem`, `/layers` and the carry-forward. The gate is `exactAddress === undefined` / `!isPackageScopedType(type)`, the same set in all three places. Right as the card asks it, wrong in its declared extent (S2) and against its first consumer (M2).
- `/layers?package=X`, X and Y both ship: Y's code → X's. Right.
- Datasource carry-forward reads X's own code layer or none. Right; pinned with the real redactor.
- Bare doc read, two enabled holders beside a stamp-less runtime entry: holder registered last → the entry, on all three doors. Right, as ruling 6893582352 and `readBareDoc` serve it.
- Same, beside a hydrated package-less row: wrong as pinned (M1).
- `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` now returns a value (`void` → `unknown`); two callers, both in the diff. Right.

### ② Semver level

Three `patch` bumps with a `!` title and a BREAKING banner; `Check Changeset` is green and the ADR-0087 marker is present. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` opens its line in both the PR body and the changeset. The level matches what the diff publishes. The changeset text itself is wrong in two places: M1 (the hydrated-row row) and S2 (the type list).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs on the head: no red. `Dogfood Regression Gate` reports success with its three shards skipped, and the PR body records the battery as not measured. Card #34247 acceptance 2 requires it: S3.
- Hand-off comment 6912074085, open item "measure a real hydration before ACCEPT" (`_provenance: 'org'` stripped from the `/layers` code layer): not answered on the PR. Read here, it is adverse: M1.
- SQL push-down: no new id materialisation or in-app join.
- Siblings: #34355 still spells `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` as `void` and edits `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`; whichever lands second re-reads the other. S1 is the same class as that PR's FAIL (record 6915442261).

### ④ Design judgment

M1 (must-fix) — the hydrated-row state the PR pins is not the state the hydrator writes, and in the hydrator's state the three bare doors disagree.
- `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` registers `stateTenantAuthorship(withRowBinding(data, …))`, so every package-less entry it lays carries `_provenance: 'org'`. The rig fixture (`meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts`, the `[#34248] a hydrated package-less row` pin) registers `_packageId: 'sys_metadata'` with no `_provenance`.
- With the marker, `getMetaItemLayered` declines the service copy (`bareDocServiceCopyDisplacesEntry`), then `runtimeOnly` drops the entry, so `code` is `null`. A shipped doc is sealed, so `declinesStoredRow` makes `effective` the code layer: `null`, where main answered an item.
- Both `/published` doors take `layered.effective` when an overlay exists and the row is declined, so they serve `null`; the new swap needs `publishedCode != null` and never runs.
- The plain read still serves the row. That is #34248 acceptance 1 failed for "entry or row" on two of three doors.
- The changeset already says "(with `code: null`)" for a stored row while the pin asserts `code: 'environment doc'`; one of them is false.
- Reachable without a reboot: a package-less doc saved while no package ships the name, then two packages that ship it are installed. When artifacts load before hydration the entry is grafted with the first holder's `_packageId` instead, and the read is the 409.
- Required: lay the fixture as the hydrator does, make `/layers` and both `/published` doors serve the row (or refuse) in that state, pin it in both orders, and correct the changeset row.

M2 (must-fix) — the first consumer of `?package=` on a doc is not carried. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx` sends `packageId: appName` as ADR-0048 prefer-local context, not as an exact address.
- A cross-reference from app X's doc to another package's doc is rewritten to `/apps/X/docs/NAME` (`doc-links.ts` rewrites every `./NAME.md` under the app's base), so it reads `?package=X` and now shows "not found". ADR-0046 designs those links.
- `appAddressSegment` uses the app NAME as the segment when a package ships more than one app. That segment is no installed package id, so every doc under such an app now answers 404.
- ADR-0150 D5 and its G1 row give this address "a refusal that names the holders", which `DocPage` already renders as a candidate list; the covered types answer 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` for the same address shape (the PR's own COVERED control). A 404 is a dead end.
- Required: carry the Console read in this PR or a landed predecessor, or answer the D5 refusal. The 404-versus-refusal choice is the card's sentence against the ADR's and goes to the maintainer; declare the Console path in the changeset either way.

S1 (should-fix) — the entry answers first only at two or more enabled holders (`refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead`, `>= 2`). With one holder beside a stamp-less entry, `readBareDoc` and `MetadataFacade.get` serve the entry and the bare doors keep the holder's service copy: the registry/door split this PR cites as the defect. Adding a second holder flips the door's answer. The one-holder CONTROL has no entry beside it. Pin that cell and declare it, or serve the entry there too.

S2 (should-fix) — the code moves `position` and `capability` as well: one holder A, `?package=B` now answers 404 (`registryAnswerAtAddress` runs for every type outside `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES` except `object`). The changeset and the FROM→TO table name eight types, and `OUTSIDE_PINNED` filters these two out with no CONTROL. Declare and pin them, or exclude them in code.

S3 (should-fix) — run the dogfood battery on the final head before landing (card #34247 acceptance 2).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `de137717ef68cdba7099a2bc52c0d52811b873ae`
Local-runs: none
Scope: NON-PROSE-PATHS + CITED-FILES — every non-prose path of the net diff, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx` and `docs-portal.test.tsx` included; cited and read on the head: objectql `registry.ts` (`packageScopedHoldersOf`, `getPackageScopedItem`), `protocol-registry-hydration.ts`, `protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`, rest `meta-item-read-routes.ts`, runtime `domains/meta.ts`, Console `DocsSlug.tsx`, `MetadataProvider.tsx`, ruling 6917064203 on #34398.
Security-touching: yes

Delta on record 6916685896 (FAIL at `989f4ad7`). The merge-base is unchanged (`6cc3f974`), so the net diff carries no main merge; the delta is commits `eaf3e5d1` and `de137717`. Nothing was run.

### ① Derived judgments

- Exact `?package=X` read, X holds none and another enabled package does: 200 → `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` `not-held-by-qualifier`, candidates = the enabled package holders other than X, on `readMetaItem` and `/layers`; X need not be installed; a name nothing holds stays 404. Right against ruling 6917064203 (B, parameters 1 to 4). Pinned for all eight types, both orders, on the composed rig and both transports.
- The carry-forward passes no `refuse`, so it carries none; the changeset says so. Right (parameter 2).
- `position`, `capability`: left out of `registryAnswerAtAddress` by `isSecurityCatalogType`; `?package=B` keeps the holder's item. Right, declared and pinned.
- `/layers` beside a hydrated package-less row: `code: null`, the row as `overlay` and `effective`; both `/published` doors follow `effective`. Right in the hydrator's state, wrong in one neighbouring state (S4).
- Console `DocPage`: a 404, or a 409 whose candidates leave out the route's segment, falls back to the read by name. Right. `DocsSlug` sends the same segment and is not carried (M2).
- `@object-ui/console` gains a `patch` bump. Right.

### ② Semver level

Four `patch` bumps under a `!` title; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` opens its line in the PR body and the changeset; `Check Changeset` is green. The changeset rows read 200 → 409 and match the tree. The PR title and body do not: S6.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs on the head: none red, none running. `Dogfood Regression Gate` reports success with its three shards skipped.
- Ruling 6917064203 parameter 5 (measure the docs audience gate against the new refusal, write it in the PR): not answered in the body, the changeset or any comment. S5.
- Parameter 6 (the Console read lands with this PR): met for `DocPage`, not for `DocsSlug` (M2).
- SQL push-down: no new id materialisation or in-app join.
- Card #34247 carries no comment amending acceptance 1 to the ruling (N1). The PR is a draft.

### ④ Design judgment

Earlier findings:
- M1: closed. The fixture is laid as `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` lays it (`_provenance: 'org'`, no `_packageId`), the three bare doors serve the row on both transports in both orders, the artifacts-first order is pinned through `loadMetaFromDb` (first holder's envelope, 409 naming both), and the changeset row is corrected.
- M2: open in part. The server answers the ruling's 409 and `DocPage` is carried. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocsSlug.tsx` `refusalFor` still reads `getItem('doc', slug, { packageId: appName })` and treats every answer but 401/403/404 as "not a refusal".
- S1: closed as a declared deviation. The one-holder cell is pinned as measured-unresolved and named under "Not moved"; no follow-up card is named (N2).
- S2: closed (excluded in code, CONTROL on the plain read and `/layers`).
- S3: open. No battery verdict on this head in the body or the comments; the body's readings are still at `72dc8ca25e`.

M2 (must-fix, carried) — `DocsSlug.refusalFor` is the flat-permalink door every cross-reference is rewritten to (`doc-links.ts`, `/apps/X/docs/NAME`). For a name the route's segment does not hold (a cross-package link, or the app-name segment of a multi-app package) it now receives the new 409, returns null, and the page falls to the name-prefix redirect or "Documentation not found". On main that read reached the audience verdict and rendered `DocRefusal` (objectui#10188). Required: give `refusalFor` the same by-name fallback `DocPage` took, and pin it under `WORLD.exact` for both segment kinds.

S4 (should-fix) — `environmentRowAnswers` in `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` holds for any bare-doc environment entry beside a package-less served row. When the entry is a stamp-less runtime registration (a code layer) and a different package-less stored row also exists, `/layers` `effective` and both `/published` doors move from the entry to the row, while the plain read keeps the entry. At `989f4ad7` the three agreed. Required: apply it only where the entry is the row's tenant-authored copy (`code` is null), and pin the mixed state.

S5 (should-fix) — answer ruling parameter 5 in the PR: on both transports, which answer a member the docs audience gate refuses receives at `?package=X` (X holds none), beside the bare two-holder 409 as the comparison, and pin it. The required order of the refusal and the gate is in the private note for the seat.

S6 (should-fix) — the PR title (the squash subject) still says "or 404" and the body's FROM→TO table, maintainer quick-read section and test notes still describe 404 and three packages; parameter 4 asks those rows to read 200 → 409. Rewrite them to the head, with the Console row.

S3 (should-fix, carried) — run the dogfood battery on the final head (card #34247 acceptance 2).

N1 (nit) — amend #34247 acceptance 1 by a comment citing the ruling. N2 (nit) — name the follow-up card for the one-holder cell.
